MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 21
   C. 9
   D. 13

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 31
   C. 43
   D. 49

3. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 36
   D. 37

4. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 90

7. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 18

9. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 24

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 156

11. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

12. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 65

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
